dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The structure is defined by irregular, light-gray, high-contrast lines forming semi-closed 'C' and closed 'O' shapes; the perimeter geometry exhibits a sharp, non-linear gradient transition from the charcoal-gray exterior base to the high-intensity light border, which encloses a darker-gray interior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters; these are primarily concentrated as discrete spots on the distal posterior flipper and sparse clusters near the lateral neck crease.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the two largest mid-lateral closed loops and the centroid of the prominent dorsal-anterior 'C' shape form a scalene triangle with its longest side oriented along the longitudinal axis of the body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized, pink, fleshy feature is visible protruding from the ventral boundary of the midsection; a distinct dark linear furrow is present at the junction between the head and the main body mass.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five high-intensity white micro-spots is arranged in a linear pattern on the upper margin of the posterior flipper.
